observations: Copied the complete120-frame beat into a; reselected a before Group. The copied-range display stayed [0..120) throughout.
Grouped [0..7) as First 答え; inspected actual native heading, beat card and footer at2x scale.
Enter opened the seven-frame group and Backspace returned to the parent.
Selected fresh [7..12) and dot grouped it with the retained label.
Ungroup promoted the second group; one Undo restored it. Dot ungrouped the newly selected first group; Undo restored it.
Started qz only after the Undo receipt, recorded :ungroup, saved q and verified one instruction.
Undo restored the first group; native @z removed it as one Undo. One Undo restored it, retaining register a.
Cmd-Q exited cleanly; closed reads retained both named groups, edited register a and Macro z.
limits: CUA typeText delivered only the ASCII part of the initial name; exact Unicode was entered through native paste. This does not qualify physical keyboard or OS IME composition.
A batched Undo and recording start produced no retained recording after the revision change. The checked recording waited for the Undo receipt before qz.
Native QA overlapped automated compilation/checking. No native response-time measurement is claimed.
Developer bundle uses external build-host libraries; no signing or standalone packaging qualification.
